explanation: The 2011-08-09 document contains a major forward guidance shift — the explicit introduction of a calendar-based commitment to keep the federal funds rate at 0-1/4% 'at least through mid-[year]' (mid-2013), a first-of-its-kind date-based forward guidance that represented a substantive regime change from prior conditional language. This announcement on August 9, 2011 is the primary candidate for explaining the structural break detected on August 18, as markets would have continued repricing the yield curve and risk assets in the days following that guidance shift.
